articulation.label: round-trip
articulation.alt: round-trip: /r/ → /aʊ/ → /n/ → /d/ → /t/ → /r/ → /ɪ/ → /p/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
/a/: Start with the tongue low and jaw open.
/ʊ/: Raise the back tongue; round the lips.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
/d/: Tip touches the ridge; add voice and release.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
/ɪ/: Front tongue, a little lower and relaxed.
/p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.
